17: 41. THERE ARE THOSE WHO SAY THAT THE LAW OF STONES, ETC. This is what the Mordechai wrote, that there is no difference and to the contrary, he wrote there that there are those who say specifically regarding branches there is a disagreement. But stones are different because they do not move. And we heard a little bit about this in the R"an ספי"ז. Therefore we can say the opinion of the Rosh on all of this, ועמ"ש סי' שכ"ה סי"א וצ"ע, how can you say there is no disagreement regarding stones? There is a disagreement specifically in the Gemara Shabbos 125! Therefore it seems to be that certainly because they (stones) do not move, certainly it is permitted to sit on them because according to everyone, it is not forbidden to touch Muktze.
42. Because if this happens, he performed an action.
